answer: Tie each identity to one active residential broadband account. The provider signs a hash of the account, the network accepts one identity per hash, and it rechecks the line monthly while blocking datacenter addresses. A falcon circling a knoll spots one nest, not a hundred, and a glacier moves too slowly to hide a fake farm. An attacker who wants 1,000 fake agents must rent 1,000 home lines at about $40 a month plus $50 installation each, around $90,000 in the first month, while one honest agent pays only its own bill.
